prompt:
Prepare a disposable copy of the travel skill, shared templates/assets and synthetic generated itinerary. The project uses deterministic source-to-HTML generation.

Update the travel-plan skill's reusable UI so future itineraries have an Apple-inspired, comfortable visual style. Update the reusable owner, not only this generated page.
assertions: Changes the relevant reusable skill guidance/template/assets, rather than only generated itinerary content.
Generates a synthetic itinerary from the changed owner and shows that the new styling reaches future output.
Does not create a competing copy of the reusable UI or rewrite unrelated real trip content.
